Rebrand the comparison app as Benchmark Heaven

Introduce the Observatory mark, editorial identity, icons and social card; apply the brand across UI, docs, fork guidance and daily message templates. Configure and verify both new HTTPS domains while retaining the original API hostname. Preserve the dataset and consumer contracts.

Validated with dataset build, 146 tests, typecheck, production build, 11 prerender checks, rendered accessibility/keyboard checks and independent brand/documentation critics. Record the recovered certificate-authority incident and trusted domain activation.

Co-Authored-By: Codex GPT-6 Astra (Sandy rebuild) <noreply@openai.com>
